description: Read-only money tracking: load bank-export files (CSV/JSON), detect subscriptions, categorize transactions against a closed category list, and watch prices with noise-suppressed alerts. Never moves money; no bank connections, no network.
name: finance

tools.description: Load a bank-export CSV or JSON file from the skill's data folder and return normalized transactions ({date, payee, amount}). Unparseable rows are skipped and counted, never fatal.
tools.name: finance_load_transactions

tools.description: Detect recurring subscriptions in transactions (weekly / every-2-weeks / monthly / yearly, dates within ±1 day, consistent amounts). Transfers and exact duplicates are excluded. Each hit carries an evidence string and the monthly-cost rollup.
tools.name: finance_detect_subscriptions

tools.description: Categorize one transaction into the owner's EXISTING category ids only (closed vocabulary). Payee-substring rules run first; without a rule hit the result is null — never an invented category. A transaction whose category is locked (human-set) is returned unchanged.
tools.name: finance_categorize

tools.description: Create (or re-baseline) a price watch in the skill's own state file. id is a URL or any label; price is the current price the owner observed. No fetching is done — prices are always owner-supplied.
tools.name: price_watch_set

tools.description: Check a watch against a new owner-supplied price. Returns alert=true ONLY when the move vs the last alerted (or baseline) price is at least threshold_pct (default 5%). Sub-threshold moves are recorded silently so slow drift still alerts once it accumulates.
tools.name: price_watch_check

tools.description: List all price watches with their baseline and last seen prices.
tools.name: price_watch_list
